rule: cell k = ground bearing 11.25k (0 down-right on screen, 45 at the viewer); the barrels at one fixed raise; the game picks the cell by aim_deg and starts the shot at muzzle
note: all entries game px from the building's origin; body@2x.png and the cells are @2x. Nothing of the body is drawn in front of the turret: its parts in front are cut out of every cell, so no front layer.
aim_note: aim_deg: on-screen direction the barrel points (0 = right, 90 = down), measured from the 3D model; muzzle: [dx, dy] game px from the pivot to the muzzle tip on screen; ground_deg: on-screen direction of the cell's heading on the ground; aim_len: barrel length on screen in game px (short = pointing at or away from the viewer).
